name: knapper
description: MCP server for Obsidian plugin development with one private vault, popout-aware UI automation, and logs.

interface.shortDescription: Develop and test one Obsidian plugin in one private vault.
interface.longDescription: Open a Git-ignored vault, link one plugin, reload it, drive Obsidian windows, and read logs and eval results.
defaultPrompt: Open a Git-ignored Obsidian vault for this plugin.
Reload this plugin and check its logs.
Exercise this plugin in the Obsidian UI.
